pattern_name: Quiet vertical coffee meditation with stacked serif titles
summary: A single centered ceramic cup on a warm neutral surface carries all information through alternating title and numbered step overlays, followed by a darkening closing frame. The transferable method is one calm hero object, minimal warm background, white serif text, numbered steps, and a fade-to-dark invitation.
hook_type: Centered still-life cup with stacked title over the rim
narrative_flow: Title card, then numbered step overlays alternating with unobstructed cup shots, then fade to dark closing invitation
visual_style: Vertical 720x1280 frame, warm beige gradient backdrop, centered matte off-white ceramic cup with brown coffee, soft diffused shadow, muted low-saturation palette, faint rising steam in later frames

editing_atoms.notes: 0.0-2.0s: centered cup cut to title overlay; reuse as a calm brand-open before listing points
2.0-12.0s: numbered step text alternates positions above/below/over the cup; reuse short numbered steps on a static hero shot
12.0-15.0s: frame darkens to near-black with stacked invitation; reuse as soft end card

reusable_rules: Open on one centered hero object against a warm neutral gradient, then place the program title in stacked white serif letters over the object to establish the calm tone before any steps.
Present each step as a short numbered phrase, moving its position from top to bottom to center so the hero object remains visible between steps.
Dim the entire frame toward black for the final invitation and repeat the same stacked serif layout and thin underline used for the opening title.
Add faint rising steam in later frames to signal a hot drink without introducing extra props or text.

observations.observation: A centered off-white ceramic cup filled with brown coffee sits on a warm beige gradient; at 2.0s bold white serif text '咖啡 小计划' stacks over the cup rim, underlined by a thin horizontal rule.
After the title, the next overlay '01 选喜欢的杯子' appears at the top of the frame at 4.0s, then disappears at 6.0s leaving the unobstructed cup.
Numbered steps progress: '02 留一点安静时间' sits at lower-left at 8.0s, then '03 慢慢享受这一杯' overlaps the cup rim at 10.0s; faint steam rises above the rim.
The frame darkens progressively after 10.0s; at 14.0s and 14.97s stacked white serif text '周末来 Craft 坐坐' with a thin underline sits on the near-black frame over the darkened cup.
